verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs say role changes and departures automatically update access, permissions, and groups. Dynamic rules provision accounts and group access as roles change, hiring flows drive role-based device setup, and offboarding automatically triggers device retrieval, with custom workflows and "you define the rules" automation layered on top. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a no-code workflow builder triggered by hire, role-change and termination events; detail on per-app provisioning and deprovisioning steps; independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing.
